body:
I noticed when a new session starts and the trip brief and itinerary are not set the agent retrieves then and sees something like:

```
focus: not set
tripLengthInDays: not set
interestsText: not set
mustSeesText: not set
comfortableDrivingInHours: not set
routePreference: not set
restDaysText: not set
usualStartTime: 8:00 a.m.
defaultTier: not set
budgetRulesText: not set
mealPreferencesText: not set
```

and 

```
The whole itinerary.
Start place: not set yet.
End place: not set yet.
Start date: not set yet. 1 day. 0 m of road time in all, without the drive buffer.

Day 1 (day_aj8ngcxs), date not set yet: start or end place not set yet. Last day. Starts 8:00 a.m., the usual start time.
- No leg.
Schedule: nothing yet.

Rejected places: none.

Check results: none.
```

Could be a small optimization to minimize these responses to something like `New trip and nothing has been set yet`.
